GiveWell funded trials there on eyeglasses for workers and other programs. GiveWell published 2 public models of its work; the most recent, from May 2024, puts it at **4.9× GiveDirectly (GW: 13× cash)**.

GiveWell states results as multiples of its cash benchmark. GiveDirectly itself scores about 2.6× that benchmark in GiveWell's own model, so GiveWell's multiples look 2.6 times smaller here, where everything is compared with GiveDirectly.

| Model | By | Date | Result | Cells reproduced |

| [EARN RCT VoI BOTEC [2024]](/lshtm) | GW | May 2024 | 4.9× GiveDirectly (GW: 13× cash) | 96 |
| [Eyeglasses for workers CEA [2024]](/lshtm/lshtm-eyeglasses-workers-2024) | GW | May 2024 | 5.9× GiveDirectly (GW: 15× cash) | 24 |
